title: Ability DSL condition
description: A predicate, or and/or/not over predicates. Every predicate sits on one axis (clock, army, identity, composition, state, history, position, board, attack, visibility, designation, resource) and names the unit it tests with `subject` (a unit-ref, default this-unit). Negation is only the `not` operator.

oneOf.title: phase-is condition
oneOf.description: [clock] It is this phase.

oneOf.title: player-turn-is condition
oneOf.description: [clock] It is this player's turn.

oneOf.title: battle-round condition
oneOf.description: [clock] The battle round is within [min, max].

oneOf.title: rule-active condition
oneOf.description: [army] This army or detachment rule is active now (a doctrine, Waaagh!, a pact).

oneOf.title: has-keyword condition
oneOf.description: [identity] The subject carries every keyword in all_of and at least one in any_of (or the keyword `chosen_by` an ability had the player pick). Designations (RILED UP, SPOTTED) are `designated`, not keywords.

chosen_by.description: The keyword this ability had the player pick (at the start of the battle), rather than a fixed keyword.

oneOf.title: owned-by condition
oneOf.description: [identity] The subject belongs to this player.

oneOf.title: has-ability condition
oneOf.description: [identity] The subject has this ability (Deep Strike, Oath of Moment, a Discipline).

oneOf.title: same-unit condition
oneOf.description: [identity] The subject is the same unit as `as` (not(same-unit) is 'another unit').

oneOf.title: attachment condition
oneOf.description: [composition] leading: the subject model is leading a unit (matching `with`, if given). led: the subject unit is led by a Leader matching `with`. attached: the subject is part of an attached unit.

oneOf.title: strength condition
oneOf.description: [composition] The subject is below its Starting Strength, or below Half-strength.

oneOf.title: model-count condition
oneOf.description: [composition] The subject has this many models (with `keyword`, if given).

oneOf.title: model-profile condition
oneOf.description: [composition] The subject model uses this datasheet model profile (Szarekh, not a Triarchal Menhir).

oneOf.title: wounds condition
oneOf.description: [composition] lost: the subject has lost wounds. remaining_max: it has at most this many left. damaged: it is in its datasheet's Damaged bracket.

oneOf.title: loadout condition
oneOf.description: [composition] Each model (with model_keyword, if given) carries identical weapons of this kind.

oneOf.title: unit-state condition
oneOf.description: [state] The subject is in this core-rules state. `with` narrows engaged to one unit; `at` reads the state at an earlier point.

oneOf.title: eligible condition
oneOf.description: [state] The subject is eligible to do this. be-selected: eligible for `source_ability`'s selection.

oneOf.title: happened condition
oneOf.description: [history] An event happened within `window`: the subject did it, to the object, matching the filter, at least count_min times (default 1).

oneOf.title: happened-compare condition
oneOf.description: [history] Compares how many times two events happened (mission cards).
The current value of a resource pool (a pledged number).

oneOf.title: within condition
oneOf.description: [position] The subject is within `range` of `of`. models: every means every model of the subject; wholly means wholly within. `at` reads the position at an earlier point.

oneOf.title: in-region condition
oneOf.description: [position] The subject is inside a region (wholly, if set).

oneOf.title: closest condition
oneOf.description: [position] The subject is the closest of `among` to `to` (default the attacker), within `range` if given.

oneOf.title: controls condition
oneOf.description: [board] A player (default you) controls objectives matching the filter: at least count_min (default 1), at most count_max. compare: more-than-opponent means more objectives than the opponent.

oneOf.title: attack-is condition
oneOf.description: [attack] The attack being resolved matches every filter.

oneOf.title: attack-compare condition
oneOf.description: [attack] Compares a stat of one side of the attack with a stat of the other, or with a value.

oneOf.title: roll-result condition
oneOf.description: [attack] A roll came out this way.

oneOf.title: visible condition
oneOf.description: [visibility] The subject is visible (fully visible, if set) to `to` (default the attacker). With blocked_by, the view is instead blocked by that unit.

blocked_by.description: The view is blocked by this unit: the subject is not (fully) visible to `to` because of it.

oneOf.title: designated condition
oneOf.description: [designation] The subject carries this designation. With count_min/count_max, counts how many units or objectives carry it.

by.description: The unit that applied the designation (their Spotted unit; one marked by a MARKERLIGHT Observer).

oneOf.title: resource condition
oneOf.description: [resource] A resource pool holds at least / at most this much. below_max: fewer uses than its maximum have been spent.

oneOf.title: operation-markers condition
oneOf.description: [board] Mission: operation markers on the battlefield.

oneOf.title: engagement-fronts condition
oneOf.description: [board] Mission: you are engaged on at least count_min fronts.

oneOf.title: destroyed-while-on-objective condition
oneOf.description: [board] Mission: enemy units destroyed on, or by a unit on, an objective.

oneOf.title: destroyed-in-tagged-terrain condition
oneOf.description: [board] Mission: enemy units destroyed in (or that started the turn in) designated terrain.

oneOf.title: battle-size condition
oneOf.description: [clock] The battle is being played at this battle size.

oneOf.title: army-faction condition
oneOf.description: [army] Your Army Faction is this faction.

oneOf.title: moved-over condition
oneOf.description: [history] The subject (default the unit being checked) was moved over by `by` during that move (window event) or in the window.

oneOf.title: guided condition
oneOf.description: [designation] The subject (default this unit) is Guided: it has For the Greater Good, is not an Observer, and is targeting one or more Spotted units.

event-bound-reference.$comment: A game object a sibling trigger bound with binds_event_variable. event_var is an internal linking id and is never rendered.

event-target.description: What the event was aimed at: a unit, or (for actions) an objective or terrain area.
